guinea.title: Gulf of Guinea maritime briefing workshop (fictional)
guinea.topic: Agree on a format for a simulated regional maritime briefing.

options.coastal: Use a joint briefing delivered by the participating coastal offices.
options.briefing: Use a joint briefing co-hosted by a regional coordination office and coastal offices.
options.regional: Use a briefing delivered by the regional coordination office, with coastal offices submitting written inputs.
options.review: Commission a single written review and hold no briefing this cycle.

iraq.title: Iraq consultation summary workshop (fictional)
iraq.topic: Agree on a format for recording a simulated consultation about a mission review. The workshop leaves the official mandate and review deadlines untouched.

options.public: Publish attributed consultation summaries and a consolidated note.
options.aggregate: Publish only a consolidated note with no attributed submissions.
options.hybrid: Publish a consolidated note and send an attributed annex to the consultation participants only.
options.closed: Send attributed summaries to participants only and publish no consolidated note.
